shared_elements: low-relief animal with legs and tail rendered flatly
animals arranged in a row/register on a rectangular stone surface
band of repeated motifs along the top of the surface
justification: Both surfaces depict quadruped animals in strict profile carved in relief on rectangular architectural elements, with a horizontal band of repeated motifs running along the upper edge and animals aligned in a register facing the same way. The biggest difference in content is that B presents a crowded multi-register program including birds, a snake and rows of abstract arched signs, while A shows only two quadrupeds, one of them a bulky three-dimensional crouching beast rather than a flat outline figure.
